source: Verified refresh 2026-10-30: employer career pages and public job-board listings checked. LinkedIn and Indeed were not searched through the connected Chrome extension in this run; some public listings indexed by search were reviewed separately. Existing feed entries and stable IDs retained; additions deduplicated by URL and employer/title/location. No application tracker, feedback, notes, or Supabase/local data modified.

jobs.title: Content Marketing Manager
jobs.summary: Produce editorial franchises for Bulldog Reporter plus blog, webinar and thought-leadership campaign content; coordinate internal and external contributors and use performance data to improve output.
jobs.fit: UJA flagship publications and editorial calendars, AthletesCAN digital content/SEO, and Mile 27 PR experience align with editorial production, campaign content and contributor management.
jobs.gap: The role expects high-volume AI-first production and deep fluency in PR-industry audiences; Jacob's direct AI-first workflow experience is not established.

jobs.company: University Health Network / Princess Margaret Cancer Foundation
jobs.title: Manager, Communications
jobs.summary: Lead earned media, strategic relationships with Princess Margaret Cancer Centre, fundraising and research storytelling, senior counsel, town halls, and issues/crisis communications.
jobs.fit: UJA's $78M+ annual campaign content and senior-leadership advisory align with philanthropic storytelling, while AthletesCAN adds media-contact experience.
jobs.gap: Direct health/science media relationships and demonstrated ownership of crisis communications are not established in the resume details.

jobs.title: Senior Communications Manager — 12-Month Contract
jobs.summary: Advise a Regional President and regional leaders on communications strategy, change adoption, employee engagement, town halls, presentations, newsletters, digital channels and emerging issues.
jobs.fit: UJA senior-leadership advisory, strategic content planning and cross-functional campaigns align with executive messaging and employee engagement.
jobs.gap: Direct banking-sector experience is not established; the listed range is broad. The posting mentions bilingual-distribution requirements but does not explicitly require the candidate to be bilingual.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Manager
jobs.summary: Lead integrated audience-growth and brand-marketing programs to introduce new audiences to the Globe's journalism and products, grow digital subscriptions, and improve discoverability across social, video and emerging platforms.
jobs.fit: UJA content strategy and campaign work, plus AthletesCAN digital growth and analytics, align with audience development and multi-channel marketing.
jobs.gap: The role emphasizes measurable audience acquisition, paid/organic growth and sponsorship/partnership marketing; direct subscription-growth ownership is not established.

jobs.title: Content Marketing Manager (Remote Canada)
jobs.summary: Own content-marketing strategy and performance across SEO, paid search, paid social and conversion optimization for a portfolio of clients in B2B and technical verticals.
jobs.fit: AthletesCAN website/SEO work, Google Analytics and Google Ads, and Mile 27 client leadership provide relevant digital and agency foundations.
jobs.gap: The role leans heavily on technical SEO audits, paid-media performance and conversion optimization beyond the strongest evidence in Jacob's communications background.

jobs.title: Director, Communications
jobs.summary: Lead integrated communications, media relations, executive thought leadership, digital strategy, reputation and stakeholder engagement for the Faculty of Health Sciences; advise the Vice-President & Dean and lead staff.
jobs.fit: Jacob's health-sciences master's degree, UJA senior-stakeholder communications and content leadership align with research storytelling and integrated communications strategy.
jobs.gap: The posting requires 10+ years of progressively responsible experience and senior leadership; Jacob's documented experience is about nine years and director-level team leadership is not fully established.

jobs.title: Commercial Communications Manager — 12-Month Contract
jobs.summary: Advise commercial leaders and lead internal/external communications, town halls, national sales-conference content, scripts and communications plans tied to Canadian commercial priorities.
jobs.fit: UJA senior-stakeholder counsel, campaign communications and editorial storytelling align with translating organizational priorities for multiple audiences.
jobs.gap: The posting asks for extensive beverage-industry knowledge and experience with a commercial sales organization; neither is established. Canadian French is listed as a plus, not a requirement.

jobs.title: Account Director, Earned Media Strategy
jobs.summary: Lead integrated earned-media strategy, senior client counsel and major accounts to build brand reputation and business results across consumer, corporate and healthcare brands.
jobs.fit: Mile 27 PR leadership, AthletesCAN media-relations responsibilities and UJA storytelling align with client counsel and earned-media strategy.
jobs.gap: The role expects sustained senior agency leadership and top-tier earned-media results across major accounts; the scale of Jacob's account-director experience is not fully established.

jobs.title: PR & Communications Manager
jobs.summary: Deliver PR for B2B client accounts, including earned media, press releases, executive positioning, thought leadership, organic social and performance reporting.
jobs.fit: Mile 27 PR leadership and AthletesCAN media contact experience align with hands-on PR delivery, client work and strategic storytelling.
jobs.gap: Agency experience is required and B2B/B2B technology experience is strongly preferred; Jacob's direct B2B tech portfolio is not established.

jobs.title: Product & Technology Communications Manager
jobs.summary: Build product and technology communications strategy, explain complex technical work to technical and non-technical audiences, support launches and executive thought leadership, and partner with product, research, engineering and media teams.
jobs.fit: Jacob's editorial strategy, research training, digital storytelling and senior-stakeholder counsel are transferable to clear product narratives and cross-functional communications.
jobs.gap: The posting prefers 5–7 years in product/technology communications, ideally AI, enterprise software or developer-focused environments; that specialization is not established.

jobs.title: Corporate Communications Associate II
jobs.summary: Support employee engagement through town halls, leadership events, newsletters, digital content, surveys, campaigns and SharePoint publishing for Canadian Commercial Banking.
jobs.fit: UJA content planning and stakeholder communications, plus SharePoint experience, transfer to internal engagement and colleague communications.
jobs.gap: The role emphasizes coordination and event delivery, making the scope below Jacob's manager-level target.

jobs.title: Internal Communications Specialist, Service Lines (12-Month Contract)
jobs.summary: Develop internal communications campaigns, leadership messages, newsletters and intranet content for EY service lines; coordinate with senior leaders and measure communications results.
jobs.fit: UJA leadership content, editorial planning and cross-channel communications align with internal storytelling and senior-stakeholder collaboration.
jobs.gap: The Specialist title is below Jacob's target level. English/French bilingualism is described as ideal, not required.

jobs.title: Email Marketing Cloud Specialist
jobs.summary: Coordinate email and SMS campaigns across MLSE brands, including content creation, templates, segmentation, QA, scheduling, testing, reporting and stakeholder management; one-year freelance role.
jobs.fit: Jacob's Mailchimp, Constant Contact and Stripo experience, campaign calendars and digital analytics are relevant to lifecycle communications and email execution.
jobs.gap: The posting seeks hands-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud or comparable automation experience; the Specialist scope is below target level.

jobs.title: Coordinator, Integrated Commercial Marketing — Basketball Vertical
jobs.summary: Support integrated campaigns for the Toronto Raptors and Raptors 905 across ticketing, retail, partnerships, digital, content, audience development and fan experience.
jobs.fit: Canadian Olympic Committee and AthletesCAN experience provide sport-sector context, while digital content and campaign coordination transfer to integrated commercial marketing.
jobs.gap: Coordinator-level scope is below target; direct commercial sponsorship activation and ticketing/retail partnership work are not established.

jobs.title: Coordinator, Fan Access
jobs.summary: Support a part-time, 10-month fan-engagement and loyalty program through campaigns, member communications, email and in-app content, rewards, activations and engagement reporting.
jobs.fit: Jacob's sports-sector background and digital content/campaign experience align with fan engagement and multi-channel member communications.
jobs.gap: Part-time coordinator scope is below target; direct loyalty-platform and CRM ownership are not established.

jobs.company: Infotek Consulting Inc. (client: large Canadian financial institution)
jobs.title: Senior Communications Specialist — CISO Office (6-Month Contract)
jobs.summary: Create communications content and materials for a Chief Information Security Officer's office on a six-month contract; the listing specifies four office days and one remote day weekly.
jobs.fit: Jacob's senior communications, content development and stakeholder advisory experience are transferable to executive-office communications.
jobs.gap: The listing seeks 10+ years of corporate/professional experience and security/risk or CISO-office background; cybersecurity domain expertise is a substantial gap.

jobs.title: Public Relations & Communications Manager
jobs.summary: Lead global external communications for professional and institutional products, including media materials, executive messaging, thought leadership and stakeholder communications for a crypto/financial-infrastructure business.
jobs.fit: Mile 27 PR leadership, AthletesCAN media work and executive-facing content experience align with external communications strategy and senior messaging.
jobs.gap: The posting calls for strong knowledge of and passion for crypto, with communications for professional traders and institutional audiences; that domain expertise is not established.

jobs.title: Manager, Marketing & Communications
jobs.summary: Lead marketing strategy and execution for the Foundation’s events portfolio, shaping audience strategy, messaging, channels and campaign delivery in support of its $500M Here for Life campaign.
jobs.fit: Directly relevant to UJA’s large-scale philanthropic campaign communications, donor storytelling, stakeholder engagement and hands-on campaign delivery.
jobs.gap: Events are the primary portfolio focus; confirm how much ownership the role has over broader brand, digital and content strategy.

jobs.title: Lead, Strategic Communications
jobs.work: Hybrid; candidates may work from anywhere in Canada
jobs.summary: Lead strategic communications supporting the Partnership’s national cancer-control work, translating evidence and priorities for multiple audiences.
jobs.fit: Research training, clear explanation of complex issues, strategic storytelling and nonprofit communications experience align well with knowledge translation and national stakeholder work.
jobs.gap: Health-system, public-policy or cancer-control subject expertise may be preferred; establish examples of communicating technical or research material.

jobs.title: Director, Communications
jobs.summary: Direct communications and knowledge-exchange work at a nonprofit research network, leading staff and supporting evidence-based public and sector communications.
jobs.fit: Combines nonprofit leadership, research-informed storytelling, communications strategy and team leadership; strong alignment with the user’s sport-sector and fundraising communications background.
jobs.gap: The role sits in HIV research and health knowledge exchange; confirm the current posting’s deadline and specific subject-matter requirements with the employer.

jobs.company: Ontario Council on Articulation and Transfer (ONCAT)
jobs.title: Manager of Marketing and Communications
jobs.summary: Own marketing and communications for an organization focused on Ontario’s postsecondary transfer system and learner success.
jobs.fit: Strategic content planning, research skills, clear explanation of complex systems and education/community-building experience are relevant.
jobs.gap: The role may expect postsecondary-sector familiarity and broader marketing ownership; verify the official posting and current application status.

jobs.title: External Communications Manager
jobs.summary: Lead external communications for a purpose-driven social-impact technology company, supporting media visibility and corporate storytelling.
jobs.fit: PR agency leadership, media-relations experience, nonprofit/social-impact context and executive-facing storytelling are relevant strengths.
jobs.gap: Confirm the role’s location flexibility and whether technology-sector communications experience is a firm requirement.

jobs.title: Communications & Brand Identity Manager
jobs.summary: Lead communications and brand strategy for a youth-led HIV charity, overseeing campaign materials, brand identity, media presence and youth engagement.
jobs.fit: Nonprofit communications, digital storytelling, campaign work and community-focused messaging align with the organization’s mission and role scope.
jobs.gap: Salary is undisclosed and the role is in person; confirm compensation, team size and expected design-production responsibilities.

jobs.title: Communications Manager, Equinix Foundation
jobs.summary: Lead global Foundation communications and brand narrative, thought leadership, impact storytelling, LinkedIn Showcase Page strategy, cross-functional communications and data-led impact reporting.
jobs.fit: UJA philanthropic storytelling and large-scale campaign communications, combined with AthletesCAN digital storytelling and senior-stakeholder work, align closely with impact narrative development and nonprofit partner stories.
jobs.gap: The role is global and matrixed; direct ESG/CSR and digital-inclusion subject experience is not established. The posting asks for 5–7 years and Toronto is a hybrid office location.

jobs.title: Corporate Communications Manager II
jobs.summary: Advise senior leaders on transformation, change and risk-sensitive communications; lead internal and external programs, media counsel, PR campaigns, digital content and reputational-risk communications.
jobs.fit: UJA senior-stakeholder counsel, strategic campaign communications, editorial judgment and AthletesCAN media experience align with the role's integrated communications and leadership-advisory scope.
jobs.gap: The posting prefers experience supporting capital markets, wholesale banking or financial services; direct experience in a regulated financial institution is not established.

jobs.title: Manager, Strategic Communications & Data Visualization
jobs.summary: Turn complex business information and performance metrics into executive presentations, board materials, strategic updates, dashboards, scorecards and visual narratives for leadership decisions.
jobs.fit: Research training, clear explanation of complex subjects, strategic storytelling and senior-stakeholder communications are relevant to executive-level narrative development.
jobs.gap: Advanced PowerPoint and Excel are required; Power BI/Tableau and sophisticated data visualization are preferred. The role is unusually presentation-design and quantitative-visualization heavy.

jobs.title: Senior Staff GTM Communications Manager
jobs.summary: Own global go-to-market communications channels and narrative, including all-hands, newsletters, video updates, Sales Kickoff programming and onboarding; partner with executives and GTM leaders on messaging, presentations and facilitation.
jobs.fit: Nearly a decade of communications experience, UJA leadership-facing content, national campaigns, and AthletesCAN/COC event and digital communications provide strong foundations in storytelling, executive messaging and cross-functional delivery.
jobs.gap: The role specifically seeks 8+ years in GTM, executive communications or sales enablement, plus strong B2B SaaS understanding and Sales Kickoff/onboarding experience. Direct SaaS GTM and revenue-enablement work is not established.

jobs.title: Manager, Corporate Communications and Community Affairs
jobs.salary: $140,000–$165,000 CAD total annual cash compensation (base + target bonus)
jobs.summary: Lead the Employee and Community Affairs team and drive executive and employee communications, intranet strategy, company-wide events, employer-brand initiatives and selected external communications.
jobs.fit: UJA leadership communications and community engagement, editorial/content planning, campaign delivery and cross-functional stakeholder work align with employee and community affairs leadership.
jobs.gap: The role prefers financial-services or regulated-industry experience and involves leading an established team. Confirm current location expectations as the office moves from Toronto to Mississauga.

jobs.title: Public Relations Communications Manager
jobs.summary: Own Canada's earned-media function, build proactive and reactive PR practices, develop integrated communications plans for campaigns and launches, manage media inquiries and surface stories from the host and guest community.
jobs.fit: Mile 27 PR leadership, AthletesCAN media relations and national sport storytelling align directly with earned media, proactive story development and integrated communications planning.
jobs.gap: Auto, marketplace or travel-sector experience is preferred; Quebec media relationships and French-language reach may be useful.

jobs.title: Manager, Pension Communications (12-Month Contract)
jobs.summary: Lead strategic communications and member engagement for a multi-stakeholder pension plan; develop accessible presentations, newsletters, booklets and digital content that explains complex pension information.
jobs.fit: Research training, plain-language explanation of complex topics, UJA audience-focused content and cross-stakeholder communications align closely with the core work.
jobs.gap: Pension/financial-services knowledge is an asset but not required; this is a 12-month contract and the role serves specialized member, employer and union audiences.

jobs.title: Communications Senior Manager — 14-Month Contract
jobs.summary: Lead employee communications and engagement nationally, internal events, executive communications and selected external, issues and corporate-reputation mandates.
jobs.fit: UJA leadership-facing communications, content development, campaign planning and stakeholder coordination align with employee engagement and organizational storytelling.
jobs.gap: Bilingual English/French oral and written fluency is explicitly required. Only pursue if fully bilingual; 14-month contract.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, External Communications
jobs.summary: Lead external communications strategy and advise investment groups on brand and reputation, media engagement, presentations, thought leadership, issues management and investment announcements.
jobs.fit: Strategic storytelling, senior-stakeholder counsel, media experience and research training align with explaining complex subjects to broad audiences.
jobs.gap: The role focuses on investment communications and requires translating asset-class and investment concepts; direct investment/financial-services communications experience is not established.
